approaching-army.abilityText:
After you play an Attack card, +$1.
----
Setup: Add an Attack kingdom card pile to the Supply.

biding-time.abilityText: At the start of your Clean-up, set aside your hand face down. At the start of your next turn, put those cards into your hand.

bureaucracy.abilityText: When you gain a card that doesn't cost $0, gain a Copper.

divine-wind.abilityText: When you remove the last Sun, remove all Kingdom card piles from the Supply, and set up 10 new random piles.

enlightenment.abilityText: Treasures are also Actions. When you play a Treasure in an Action phase, instead of following its instructions, +1 Card and +1 Action.

flourishing-trade.abilityText: Cards cost $1 less. You may use Action plays as Buys.

good-harvest.abilityText: The first time you play each differently named Treasure each turn, first, +1 Buy and +$1$1.

great-leader.abilityText: After each Action card you play, +1 Action.

growth.abilityText: When you gain a Treasure, gain a cheaper card.

harsh-winter.abilityText: When you gain a card on your turn, if there's D on its pile, take it; otherwise put 2D on its pile.

kind-emperor.abilityText: At the start of your turn, and when you remove the last Sun: Gain an Action to your hand.

panic.abilityText: When you play a Treasure, +2 Buys, and when you discard one from play, return it to its pile.

progress.abilityText: When you gain a card, put it onto your deck.

rapid-expansion.abilityText: When you gain an Action or Treasure, set it aside, and play it at the start of your next turn.

sickness.abilityText: At the start of your turn, choose one: Gain a Curse onto your deck; or discard 3 cards.
